definitions.explanation: Humble term used when referring to one's own mother when speaking to others outside the family.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{料理|りょうり}が{上手|じょうず}です。
examples.english: My mother is good at cooking.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{教師|きょうし}です。
{母|はは}の{日|ひ}にプレゼントをあげました。
examples.english: I gave a present on Mother's Day.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{早|はや}く{起|お}きて、{朝|あさ}ごはんを{作|つく}ってくれます。
examples.english: My mother gets up early every morning and makes breakfast for me.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}が{病気|びょうき}になったと{聞|き}いて、{心配|しんぱい}で{仕事|しごと}が{手|て}につきませんでした。
examples.english: When I heard my mother was sick, I was so worried that I couldn't concentrate on work.

notes:
{母|はは} is the humble term for "mother," used when referring to one's own mother when speaking to people outside the family.

POLITENESS SYSTEM:
- {母|はは}: my mother (humble, to outsiders)
- お{母|かあ}さん: mother (neutral, direct address or others' mothers)
- お{母|かあ}さま: mother (very polite/formal)
- ママ: mom (casual, childish)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {母|はは}の{日|ひ}: Mother's Day
- {母|はは}{親|おや}: mother (formal/written)
- {母国|ぼこく}: motherland, home country

USAGE NOTE: In casual family settings, children may call their mother お{母|かあ}さん or ママ. {母|はは} is specifically for humble reference when talking to outsiders.

RELATED: {父|ちち} (father - humble)
